drafts_today.text:
A doctor on a podcast says GLP-1 drugs should go "in the water."

I'm not buying the hype. At my age, the questions that matter are simple: am I keeping my muscle, am I eating enough protein, and what happens when I stop?

Ask those before you ask what the scale says.
drafts_today.video_tip: Talk to camera, 15 seconds, one take: read the podcast quote off your phone, then count the three questions on your fingers.

drafts_today.text:
Skin in your 70s doesn't need a 10-step routine.

It needs a gentle cleanser, something calming, one good serum, and a collagen mask when it looks tired. That's my whole RIMAN shelf.

Fewer products, done well. What's on yours?
drafts_today.video_tip: 10 seconds: line up the four products on the counter, tap each one as you name it, end on the question.

drafts_today.text:
Think your skin barrier is "broken"?

Three signs after 40: tight after cleansing, stinging when you apply anything, and flaky patches by afternoon.

The fix is boring: a gentle cleanser, fewer products for a week, and cream on damp skin. Mine is my RIMAN Incellderm routine.
drafts_today.video_tip: 12 seconds: hold up three fingers and name each sign, then show cleanser, then cream patted onto damp skin.

drafts_today.topic: No dryness cure in a jar
drafts_today.text:
Everyone's teasing a "dryness cure" this week.

After 40, mine isn't one jar. It's three habits:
1. Lukewarm water, never hot
2. Serum on damp skin
3. A richer cream at night to seal it in

Which one do you skip?
drafts_today.video_tip: 10 seconds: run the tap, test the water on your wrist, then pat serum and cream on still-damp skin. End on the question as on-screen text.

drafts_today.text:
Furnace on, skin feeling drier than ever?

Hydrating serums work best on damp skin, then sealed in right away with cream. If you put them on dry skin in dry indoor air and stop there, your face can feel tighter, not better.

Damp skin, then seal. Every time.
drafts_today.video_tip: 8 seconds: mist your face, pat on serum, follow straight away with cream. Caption: damp skin, then seal.
